chunks: And when Moses said to his servant, 'I will not cease [traveling] until I reach the junction of the two seas or continue for ages.'

key_terms.مَجْمَعَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ: The junction/confluence of the two seas

ai.seo_question: What did Moses say to his servant regarding his journey to the junction of the two seas?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse marks the pivotal moment where Prophet Moses (peace be upon him), despite his prophetic status, demonstrates humility by seeking out Al-Khidr, a servant of God endowed with 'ilm al-ladunni' (divine, experiential knowledge). The 'junction of the two seas' is often interpreted symbolically as the meeting point of the manifest (zahir) and hidden (batin) realms, underscoring the necessity for scholars to integrate both intellectual reasoning and spiritual insight.
